dct_title_s: Myanmar Cyclone Mocha: Damage and Flood Proxy Maps, May 2023
dct_description_sm: # Myanmar Cyclone Mocha: Damage and Flood Proxy Maps, May 2023 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage and flood proxy maps for Myanmar Cyclone Mocha (May 2023) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Myanmar, Cyclone Mocha, 18 May 2023, v0.9** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Myanmar, Cyclone Mocha, 18 May 2023, v0.9** - **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: Myanmar, Cyclone Mocha, 14 May 2023, v0.4** - **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: Myanmar, Cyclone Mocha, 14 May 2023, v0.3** (superseded) **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Advanced Rapid Imaging and Analysis (ARIA), NASA-JPL/Caltech, Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2023)
